Name: Fish Roe Hatchery
Author: Applepatapon
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/p64u85d.png[/img]

﻿This mod adds a machine called the 'Roe Hatchery' which allows the player to get a fish from their roes.

There are 3 types of Roe Hatchery, Basic, Advanced and Master.
[list]
[*]Basic Roe Hatchery takes 1 week. ﻿ ﻿[Costs 20 Wood, 1 Clay, and 2 Iron Bars]
[*]Advanced Roe Hatchery takes 4 days. ﻿ [Costs 10 Wood, 5 Hardwood, 1 Refined Quartz, 2 Gold Bars]
[*]Master Roe Hatchery takes 1 day. ﻿ ﻿[Costs 15 Hardwood, 3 Refined Quartz, 2 Iridium Bars]
[/list]
To obtain the recipe for the Roe Hatchery, you will have to do the following(You will receive a letter the day after meeting the requirements)
[list]
[*]Basic: Build a fish pond. 
[*]Advanced: Unlocked 'Basic Roe Hatchery' recipe. Fishing level 3.
[*]Master: Unlocked 'Advanced Roe Hatchery' recipe. Fishing level 7.
[/list]
[size=5]Notes
[/size]If you use Lookup Anything, you will see that the machines produce Sunfish. This is just visual and you will receive the correct fish.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Install Json Assets[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6529]Install Expanded Preconditions Utility[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Install Producer Framework Mod[/url].﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Install Mail Framework Mod[/url].﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Install SpaceCore[/url].﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
